title: Price Bargaining and Competition in Online Platforms: An Empirical Analysis of the Daily Deal Market
eligible_reason: Structural model of daily-deal demand (nested logit with IV for price), platform choice and merchant-platform Nash bargaining, estimated by GMM. No binary staggered treatment and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: MainAnalysis.m with gmm_obj_platform_nested.m, gmm_obj_bargains.m, constrfun_bargain.m and MeanCenter.m (market and time FE by mean-centering). Regression inventory empty (MATLAB only).
data_files_note: MainAnalysis.m header: 'the provided data are simulated values to respect the NDA agreement'; outcome and key regressors rescaled.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
